notes: Seed www.co.blanco.tx.us redirects to www.blancocountytexas.gov. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). For each target election the county posts one unofficial file (SOS 'Election Unofficial Results Report' or Electionware 'Summary Results Report', county totals) and later official canvass, summary and 'Official Precinct by Precinct' reports; no unofficial precinct report. 2024 general and 2026 primary unofficial files have creation/printed and server upload times on election night; the 2026 runoff unofficial file was scanned May 27 and uploaded May 28. Scanned files read visually.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county totals only on or after election night; precinct numbers only in official reports), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the 2024 general and 2026 primary were settled by check 2 with printed and upload times on election night.
